subject: Intro demo -> convert to cross-team POC sprint (dates / constraints)
messages:
From: Julia Ramos <julia.ramos@neptuneretail.com>
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Cc: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@neptuneretail.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro demo: Redwood Inference — request to convert to cross-team POC sprint

Hi Grace,

Thanks again for the intro demo last week. After syncing internally, our engineering and platform teams would prefer to convert the standard 60-minute product demo into a short cross-team POC sprint so we can:

- Validate end-to-end latency with our dataset
- Walk through a minimal architecture + VPC/networking requirements
- Surface any integration blockers for our procurement/security team

Our constraints: our Platform Lead (Amit) is traveling 9/21–9/23 and prefers sessions that don't overlap with travel. Procurement also wants an SLA and data residency overview as part of the kickoff.

Can we convert the meeting to a two half-day POC sprint (3 hours / half-day) the week of 9/28 or week of 10/5? I attached the POC-scoping-template we use to align goals.

Thanks — Julia
Julia Ramos
Head of Platform Engineering, Neptune Retail
julia.ramos@neptuneretail.com
+1 415-555-0198

From: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai

Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 17:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro demo: Redwood Inference — request to convert to cross-team POC sprint

Hi Julia — great to hear the team wants to move to a hands-on POC sprint. We can absolutely run a two half-day format and fold in an SLA/data residency review.

Proposed plan:
- Two half-days: Day 1 = alignment + architecture + data/connectivity prep (3 hrs)
- Day 2 = live run with sample dataset, KV/prefix caching, and performance walkthrough (3 hrs)

Availability from our side: we can do the week of 9/28 on Tue/Wed (9/29 + 9/30) or the week of 10/5 on Wed/Thu (10/7 + 10/8). Note: one of our senior infra engineers will be traveling the last week of September, but Aditya can lead the sessions if we lock the later windows.

Next steps:
1) Confirm preferred week and timezone (we'll run in PST).
2) Share any compliance artifacts you need reviewed before Day 1 (we'll have Monica on the SLA call).

I'll draft an agenda and calendar invite once you confirm.

—Grace

Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 18:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro demo: Redwood Inference — request to convert to cross-team POC sprint

Grace / Julia — quick technical note from my side:

- I can lead the architecture & performance half-day. If Amit is traveling 9/21–9/23, the latest-September window will be tight for us because our infra lead (Sofia) will also be on travel 9/29–10/1.
- To reduce risk, I recommend splitting Day 2 into two 1.5 hour blocks: (a) perf validation with a small tokenized sample, (b) integration and kv/prefix caching run. That reduces the chance of a long single session getting delayed.
- For the VPC discussion: please share your networking CIDR and whether you want a Private control plane or dedicated capacity for the POC. We'll prep a short network diagram.

Happy to cover whatever we can on 9/29 + 9/30 if you confirm now, but if you need key stakeholders from both sides, 10/7 + 10/8 is safer.

- Aditya

Thanks both — appreciate the options. A few clarifications from our side:

- Our preference is the week of 10/5 (10/7 + 10/8) so Amit and our procurement lead can join.
- Procurement would like the SLA questionnaire filled before Day 1; I attached the document they use.
- We will run the sessions in ET (we are East Coast). Can you confirm Redwood participants will block in ET?
- For the architecture session please prepare a short slide covering: data flow (ingest -> KV cache), network egress/cost considerations, and our options for Private vs Dedicated deployment.

If this is acceptable I will confirm 10/7 + 10/8 and send a single invite for two half-days.

Julia
